main_text.p: imniū gubernator, vnicuiq; noftū suā personam, velut Spartam exornandam commendauerit, eandem gnauiter, suo quisque loco, tueamur.

Quoties autem videmus istud permolestum accidere hominibus iis, qui quum honestam seu Agamēnonis, seu Nestoris seu Palamedis personā, propitia prouidentia acceperint, Thersitæ opera faciunt, & tragicè interim querūtur de suis infortuniis, quum dementiā potius suam eosdē accusare oporteat? Enimuerò, qui secundū prouerbia, uel aratro iaculatur, vel boue venatur lepo re, vel sagena ceruos venatur, si frustra laborans operam retiamque (vt ait ille) perdat: non habet cur seu fortunam, cū Ethnicis: vel Deū uerū, cū pseudochri stianis accuset: sed cur suā stulticiā, deploret. Ita qui præpostere omnia agit, eoque nomine rebus optatis non poti tur, seipsum accuset: ab errore autem refipiscens, ordine agat, post mala videli cet prudētior factus. Ita enim ne quidē incōmodi accepti sensus, carebit argumento consolationis.
Multi, quia tantū hōc ppēdunt, quā tō sint alijs inferiores, idēq; molestē ferūt

page.notes: Lower edge of the page is cut off by the scan; the last line may be incomplete. Pale show-through of the facing page is ignored. Some letters are faint: "frustra", "sagena" and "tragicè" are read with reasonable confidence; the word after "suam" in "dementiā potius suam" is clear. The line "Multi, quia tantū hōc ppēdunt, quā-tō sint" has a ruled-looking stroke under it, which is not text.
